title: Official examples declare a min_sdk_version below the store floor, and the CLI packs it
claim: The App Submission & QA Guidelines require min_sdk_version in app.json and give the current floor as 0.0.14. The four official templates in evenhub-templates declare 0.0.10, the quickstart skill tells agents to use 0.0.12, and the example on the packaging page uses 0.0.7.
actual: evenhub pack packs a manifest with min_sdk_version 0.0.10 and gives no warning about it, while it rejects other review items such as a name over 20 characters. The templates' names also contain "Even", which the guidelines say is rejected automatically, and pack accepts that too.
impact: An app started from an official template or the quickstart skill packs cleanly and meets the floor only at review.
workaround: Set min_sdk_version to the store floor or later and rename the app before submitting. osg-lint --device even-g2 --manifest app.json checks both.
repro: Run evenhub pack app.json dist on the minimal template's app.json.

evidence.note: The minimal template's app.json packed with only a warning that min_app_version 2.0.0 was raised to 2.2.10. The same file with a 26-character name was rejected.
